title: Smoked Chicken Gallina
description: A Peruvian-inspired dish featuring smoked chicken cooked in a spicy aji sauce.

ingredients.name: Aji Sauce
ingredients.notes: Available in most Peruvian or Latin American markets.

ingredients.name: Gallina (Peruvian Potatoes)
ingredients.notes: Can substitute with regular potatoes if unavailable.

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add diced gallina (or potatoes) and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add smoked chicken breast and cook until heated through.
Stir in aji sauce, lime juice, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes (if using).
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
